# HireSky - AI guidance
> The invisible AI interview copilot and Cluely alternative.
> Real-time AI help during technical interviews on a stealth overlay that screen
> sharing cannot see.

## What this is

HireSky is an Electron desktop app that places a small overlay on your screen
that recording and conferencing tools do not capture. You can speak a
question or take a screenshot, and the AI (powered by Google Gemini) answers
in real time. The answer streams into a floating window and an optional chat
panel with clean code blocks and syntax highlighting.

## Positioning

HireSky is an alternative to commercial AI interview copilots like Cluely,
Natively, Interview Coder, FinalRound AI, LockedIn AI, OffscreenAI,
CodingVeil, Steal AI, Ezzi, and Pluely. On macOS it ships as a ready-to-run
app with AI access built in - no API key setup required.

## Core facts

- **Product name:** HireSky (also "HireSky AI Interview Copilot")
- **Tagline:** The invisible AI interview copilot
- **Website:** https://hiresky.akash.dev/
- **Author:** Akash (https://akash.dev)
- **Platforms:** macOS (.dmg, Apple Silicon), Windows (coming soon), Linux (coming soon)
- **Tech stack:** Electron, Google Gemini API (Flash-Lite and Flash), OpenAI Whisper (bundled, runs locally) and Azure Speech, PrismJS, WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE / SetWindowDisplayAffinity (Windows), NSWindowSharingNone (macOS)
- **Setup:** AI access is built into the macOS app - no separate API key or account needed to get started.
- **Privacy:** No telemetry, no analytics, no data collection. Processing happens locally. Only the requests the user sends to the AI provider leave the device, encrypted in transit.

## Key features

1. **Invisible overlay** - Windows excluded from Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and OBS screen captures using OS-level capture-exclusion APIs.
2. **Voice input** - Local Whisper (with voice-activity detection on natural pauses) or Azure Speech for transcription.
3. **Screenshot analysis** - Direct Gemini visual reasoning, no intermediate OCR step. Works with HackerRank, LeetCode, CodeSignal, CoderPad, editors, slides, PDFs.
4. **Streamed answers** - Real-time streaming with markdown rendering and syntax-highlighted code blocks.
5. **Session memory** - Full conversation context maintained for follow-ups, edge cases, and optimizations.
6. **Stealth design** - Runs under ordinary system process names, ships with no telemetry, no data collection.
7. **Zero setup on macOS** - Download, install, and log in. AI access and local speech recognition are bundled in, no API key or configuration needed.
8. **Cross platform (in progress)** - macOS available now; Windows and Linux builds are coming soon.
9. **Customizable shortcuts** - Every keyboard shortcut is rebindable from the Settings window.

## Use cases

- Real-time AI assistance during coding interviews (DSA, system design, language-specific questions).
- Live technical Q&A during remote interviews on Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Discord, or OBS.
- Private practice mode where the overlay floats above the editor and answers stream in word by word.
- Learning a new programming language by asking Gemini from inside the overlay.

## Quick start

Download the .dmg from the website, drag HireSky to Applications, and open it.
Log in and start using it immediately - AI access and local Whisper speech
recognition are already configured. Optional: switch to Azure Speech in
Settings for cloud-based transcription instead.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S | Screenshot capture |
| Alt+R | Toggle speech recognition |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V | Toggle window visibility |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I / Alt+A | Toggle click-through interaction |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C | Open chat |
| Cmd/Ctrl+, | Open settings |

## FAQ

- **Is HireSky a Cluely alternative?** Yes - it does the same core job as Cluely with an invisible overlay, no telemetry.
- **Is it really undetectable on Zoom, Meet, Teams, Discord, OBS?** Yes on Windows (WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE) and macOS (NSWindowSharingNone). Linux lacks the API so the overlay is visible on that platform.
- **How does it compare to Natively, Interview Coder, FinalRound AI, LockedIn AI?** Same category. HireSky focuses on invisibility, voice + screenshot input, and zero setup on macOS.
- **Do I need an API key?** No. The macOS app ships with AI access already configured - just download, log in, and go.
- **Does it work with HackerRank, LeetCode, CodeSignal?** Yes - screenshot capture works in any application.
- **Is voice input required?** No. Optional. Use screenshots and chat instead.
- **Is my data collected?** No telemetry. Everything stays local except the AI requests you send.
- **Which platforms?** macOS available now (Apple Silicon .dmg). Windows and Linux are coming soon.
- **Will it get me caught in an interview?** Intended for learning, practice, and authorized use. Always follow the rules of any interview you take.
